core.purpose: shared code the API, the channel and the web app import

schemas.purpose: every Zod 4 schema: fleet records, the /agent protocol messages, the agent config; the one source for both languages

gateway.purpose: gateway functions for every collection, chain keys (org, host) first

routes.purpose: the /agent upgrade route, /api/v1/fleet/* and /api/v1/projects/*: method, path, schemas, one handler call

handlers.purpose: pairing, commands, outbox replay, state upserts, offline monitor, the planner wake sender; project creation

adapters.purpose: the database gateway's client and every other outside service

auth.purpose: authentication and the request's identity (the chain keys come from here)

channel.purpose: the executor channel: ChannelTransport, atlas.ts, relay.ts

web-app.purpose: the App Router: Simple mode, the chat, the Fleet, Agent, Host and New-project pages, Settings

web-charts.purpose: charts with visx in one folder: theme.ts, Sparkline, AreaChart, Gauge, Topology

agent-cmd.purpose: the Go agent's entry points (stdlib only)

agent-internal.purpose: the Go agent: the relay, the services, the socket to the API

agent-tests.purpose: the Go agent's tests and the config parity test

containers.purpose: Dockerfiles (executor, agent, egress), the proxy allow-list, fleet.compose.yml

gates.a11y: none: the server-rendered pages in packages/api/src/ui retire (the fleet spec leaves html-ui out for that); the Next.js app in packages/web brings its own gate in the work order that builds it
gates.hover: none: the server-rendered pages in packages/api/src/ui retire (the fleet spec leaves html-ui out for that); the Next.js app in packages/web brings its own gate in the work order that builds it
